notes: Extents are the documented overall envelopes. Finger-grip depths in vigil.pdf are rounded to 0.1 mm and include surface texture, so documented_extents_mm is 0.1.

Re-export tolerances are set from a CGAL export of the committed sources: bounding boxes matched exactly, vertex mismatch stayed under 0.0001 mm, and relative volume error stayed under 2e-7. The default Manifold backend does not reproduce these meshes.

The anatomical through-test uses 55 rays because vigil.md records 55 longitudinal lines inside the 25 × 6 mm webbing rectangle. Finger slots use a 40 × 6 mm band rectangle inset by 0.5 mm, plus probes 0.6 mm inside and outside the 44 × 8 mm clear opening.

finger_band.source: vigil.md and vigil.pdf page 6. The clear slot is 44 × 8 mm with its long side along grip height (Z) and its short side along depth (Y). The band section that must pass is up to 40 mm wide and 6 mm thick. Rays travel along X through the rear rail. Slot center Y is nominal body depth × 0.23 and Z is height × 0.515, which rounds to the center height printed on page 6.

models.extents_source: vigil.md and vigil.pdf page 1: overall envelope 108 × 64 × 140 mm.

passage.source: vigil.md: 55 longitudinal lines inside the 25 × 6 mm webbing rectangle, and a narrowest section of 29 × 10 mm. Station z = 70 mm lies in the unflared part of the channel (the flare returns to zero between about 4 mm and 123 mm). Solid probes are 0.6 mm outside the 29 × 10 mm flats; void probes are 0.8 mm inside them. The channel axis is centered at x = 0, y = 0.
